purpose: Normalize selected-state metadata into the existing producer selection-receipt schema without loading tensor payloads, then fill B1 by the identical rule.

loader_metadata.seed_provenance: native fixed-fit schedule/runner uses seed 4010; strict loading of serialized tensors makes initialization seed numerically irrelevant, but the packaged metadata remains fit-accurate.

state_read_algorithm: decode the little-endian uint64 safetensors header length
read exactly that many JSON header bytes
do not read tensor payload bytes or import torch

normalized_fields.state_sha256: selected_state.sha256 (the selected file digest already bound by selected-state-binding.json)

expanded_fixed.fill_rule: Apply header_only_normalization to the B1 selected-state-binding.json and selected.safetensors using the same fields and checks as current_fixed; do not infer B1 values from B0 or from draft manifests.

existing_cli_after_b1_available.selection_receipt_command: env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/trr0012_package.py selection-receipt --b0-state outputs/TRR-0012/fixed_fits/native_pair_live_r4/current_fixed_replication_1/selected.safetensors --b1-state outputs/TRR-0012/fixed_fits/native_pair_live_r4/expanded_fixed_replication_1/selected.safetensors --b0-binding experiments/TRR-0012/package/B0_selection_binding.json --b1-binding experiments/TRR-0012/package/B1_selection_binding.json --output outputs/TRR-0012/model-package/receipts/selection_complete_before_smoke.json --development-labels-used true
deferred_until: root releases the package preparation lease

package_config_overrides.state_metadata_source: normalized binding loader_kwargs, not old draft seed 4005

guarded_copy_policy.existing_regular_file: accept only after SHA-256 equality with the intended source
guarded_copy_policy.existing_symlink_or_different_file: fail closed; preserve the prior attempt

guarded_copy_function: copy_or_verify() { src="$1"; dst="$2"; test -f "$src" && test ! -L "$src" || return 1; if test -e "$dst" || test -L "$dst"; then test ! -L "$dst" || return 1; test "$(sha256sum "$src" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum "$dst" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1; return 0; fi; install -m 0444 "$src" "$dst"; }
